description: Idol of the Huntress Item Level 60 Binds when picked up Unique Relic Idol Classes: Druid Engrave your cloak with the Improved Swipe rune: While in Cat Form, your Swipe ability becomes Swipe (Cat), and while in Bear Form, your Swipe ability strikes up to 7 additional enemies. Swipe (Cat) Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 250% weapon damage and generating 1 combo point on your current target. "Kill 5 sleeping targets while in Cat Form. Then, use this idol to learn a new ability." Added in Season of Discovery. May not be in WoW: Forever.
